record.rationale: Browser binding for consumed uprv_tzset/uprv_tzname_clear_cache/uprv_tzname/uprv_timezone hooks. Intl exposes a semantic IANA/fixed-offset identity; actual pinned ICU factories provide its standard offset. The browser has no independent libc standard-bias/abbreviation channel. Unmapped/failed identities use the original empty-name host-remapping-failure channel. There are no sampled seasonal dates or independent timezone-rule heuristics. Native detection decisions are implemented separately in timezone.default.ts; independent OS raw-bias equivalence and native platform ABI are not certified.
